{{Quote|I want to know more about the life forms in this region. I want to know how they function, how they move&hellip;and how much pressure they can take before they burst.|Azca|<ref name="Inv02" />|translated=!}}
'''Azca''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] who [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] a [[Azca's miid ro'ik|''miid ro'ik'']] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] as part of [[Azca's fleet|one]] of the empire's [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]]. Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the Yuuzhan Vong [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Azca's fleet [[Skirmish between the Pythea and a Yuuzhan Vong fleet|encountered]] the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Pythea]]'' while on its way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Artorias]].

The commander had the crew of one of his fleet's [[Yorik-vec assault cruiser|''yorik-vec'' assault cruisers]] board the ''Pythea'' in hopes of learning how much pressure the galaxy's inhabitants could take before they broke. However, the vessel's crew&mdash;[[Panha]] and [[Sarkkin]]&mdash;[[Death/Legends|eliminated]] the Yuuzhan Vong boarders. Panha realized that they could not defeat Azca's forces, ramming the ''Pythea'' into Azca's ''[[miid ro'ik]]'' cruiser, killing much of the commander's crew.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Commander Azca, the ship is coming this way. The boarding party must have seized control already.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Good. Wha&mdash;? They're picking up speed!|A Yuuzhan Vong and Commander Azca|<ref name="Inv02" />|translated=!}}
A [[Yuuzhan Vong]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Azca served the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] as the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of a [[Azca's miid ro'ik|''miid ro'ik'']] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that was part of a Yuuzhan Vong [[Azca's fleet|fleet]] around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the Yuuzhan Vong [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At the edge of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], while traveling to the<ref name="Inv02" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Artorias system/Legends|Artorias system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Artorias]], the fleet [[Skirmish between the Pythea and a Yuuzhan Vong fleet|encountered]] the ''[[Pythea]]'', a [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] crewed by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Panha]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Sarkkin]].<ref name="Inv02" />

[[File:InvasionYuuzhanVong.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Azca speaks with a Yuuzhan Vong warrior aboard their cruiser]]
As they wished to learn how much pressure those who lived in the galaxy could take before breaking, Azca had a group of their [[Warrior caste|warriors]] board the ''Pythea'' instead of destroying the starship from afar. A [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong (Azca)|Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] asked their commander why they had not ordered the enemy vessel's destruction. Azca then explained their wishes to the other, who soon reported that the ''Pythea'' was approaching the commander's [[Miid ro'ik|cruiser]].<ref name="Inv02" />

The warrior believed that the boarding party had captured the exploration vessel, which pleased Azca; however, the boarders had been
[[Death/Legends|eliminated]] by Panha and Sarkkin. The former realized that they could not defeat the Yuuzhan Vong, ramming Azca's miid ro'ik cruiser, severely damaging it, and killing much of its crew.<ref name="Inv02" />

==Personality and traits==
The commander was a member of the Yuuzhan Vong warrior [[Yuuzhan Vong castes|caste]]. Azca had [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and white skin.<ref name="Inv02" />

==Equipment==
Azca wore a [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] and [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|vonduun crab armor]]. They were armed with an [[amphistaff]],<ref name="Inv02" /> a Yuuzhan Vong melee [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Azca appeared in the [[Invasion 0, Part 2|second part]] of the prologue issue of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series,<ref name="Inv02" /> which was released on [[StarWars.com]] on [[May 8]], [[2009]].<ref name="RD">{{SWArchive|url=invasion/index.html|text=''Star Wars Invasion'' Preview}}</ref> The issue was written by [[Tom Taylor]] and illustrated by [[Colin Wilson]].<ref name="Inv02" />
